major_concerns: Verifier fidelity vs production semantics (false positives/negatives) may drive observed effects.
Synthetic intent set may not represent operator ambiguity or adversarial cases.
Repair loop may induce LLM gaming of verifier rather than genuine correctness.
Power/MDE justification for N=300 not fully specified.
Failure taxonomy and labeling rules under-specified.
required_design_repairs: Validate verifier fidelity on a held-out set with known-ground-truth failures; report verifier false-positive/negative rates.
Broaden and document intent corpus (include real-world-like ambiguities and edge cases); provide sampling/seed list.
Specify and pre-register stopping rules and anti-gaming measures for repair loop (e.g., verifier oracle checks, diversity constraints).
Provide statistical power/MDE calculation motivating N=300 and fallback plan if effect smaller.
Define and pre-register detailed failure taxonomy and labeling procedure; store raw logs and hashes.

major_concerns: Verbalized confidence is manipulable and may not reflect true model uncertainty.
Access to token-level logprobs may be unavailable for some hosted LLMs or inconsistent across models.
Sampling M=8 may be insufficient for stable agreement estimates and AUC estimation.
Class imbalance (safe vs unsafe) may bias AUC and thresholds.
Proxy definitions and extraction methods not fully prespecified.
required_design_repairs: Confirm availability of required model outputs (logprobs) or define feasible proxies (e.g., ensemble agreement, edit-distance measures).
Increase sampling budget or justify M=8 with power analysis; pre-register sampling schedule and random seeds.
Pre-register exact proxy computations, calibration metrics, and multiple-comparison correction procedures.
Plan for class-imbalance handling (stratified sampling or reweighting) and report precision-recall alongside AUC.
Include sensitivity analyses across task types and LLM variants (or explicitly limit claims to tested models).

major_concerns: Realism and coverage of 'adversarial' intent generation is uncertain and may under- or over-estimate risk.
Simulated human-approval model may poorly approximate real operator behavior and bias results.
Mitigation effectiveness depends heavily on verifier fidelity and human-model parameters.
Ethical/operational realism constraints for adversarial content need documentation.
required_design_repairs: Define and document adversarial-intent generation process; validate with domain experts or held-out red-team examples.
Specify and justify simulated human decision models (latency distribution, error rates); run wide sensitivity sweeps and report dependence of conclusions on these parameters.
Pre-register mitigation implementations and verifier configurations; include fidelity checks and example failure traces.
Add ethical review/checklist for adversarial experiments; ensure outputs are sandboxed and non-actionable outside test harness.

major_concerns: Rollback emulation may oversimplify operational rollback complexity and interdependence of actions.
Small/compact benchmark risks being gamed or overfitted by tuned pipelines.
Topology and intent diversity (6 topologies, 200 intents) may be insufficient to generalize across real deployments.
Scoring protocols need precise formalization to avoid ambiguous interpretation.
required_design_repairs: Precisely define rollback semantics and limitations of emulation; include examples of irreversible vs reversible states.
Design benchmark anti-overfitting measures (hidden test split, challenge submissions protocol) and publish evaluation harness with seed-controlled reruns.
Increase topology/intent diversity or justify representativeness; include at least one realistic topology sourced from public traces if available.
Formally specify scoring protocols and edge cases, include reference implementations and end-to-end reproducibility checks; publish artifacts and hashes.
